aboutpara: I'm a postdoctoral researcher in Mo Lotfollahi's group at the Wellcome Sanger Institute. I work where machine learning meets single-cell and spatial genomics, developing methods to understand how tissue context shapes cell states, with a focus on the tumour microenvironment in clear cell renal cell carcinoma and pancreatic cancer. I trained in biotechnology at the University of Pavia and in systems biology at ETH Zurich, and did my PhD at the University of Turin, working on tumour-associated macrophages in pancreatic cancer.

resume.tagline: 👋 Computational biologist at the interface of machine learning and spatial genomics.
resume.description: I develop and apply machine learning methods to single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data, with a particular interest in macrophages, the tumour microenvironment and immunotherapy response.
